api_token.title: IPInfo API Token
api_token.description: Your ipinfo.io API token. Leave blank to run in the free Lite tier (country and ASN basics). Sign up at https://ipinfo.io/signup.

cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl.description: How long per-IP results are cached before re-fetching.

cache_size.title: Cache Size (entries)
cache_size.description: Maximum cached IP results before oldest-first eviction.

tools.name: ipinfo_check_residential_proxy
tools.description: Classify whether an IP is a known residential-proxy exit node.

tools.name: ipinfo_generate_map_url
tools.description: Build an interactive ipinfo.io map for a set of IPs.

tools.name: ipinfo_lookup_ips
tools.description: Geolocate one or more IPs and return ISP/ASN details.

tools.name: ipinfo_lookup_my_ip
tools.description: Geolocate the calling client's own IP. No arguments.

tools.name: ipinfo_summarize_ips
tools.description: Aggregate one or more IP lookups into counts and percentages.
